description: Line 674: 'a.value() == b.value()' compares DER content bytes without comparing tag bytes. For non-string DirectoryString values, if two values have the same content but different tags (e.g., theoretical SEQUENCE vs SET), they would incorrectly match. Should be: 'a.tag() == b.tag() && a.value() == b.value()' for safety. Current practical risk is LOW (different content for different values), but spec-correct behavior requires tag comparison.
title: Missing tag comparison in ava_values_match (None, None case)
